assets.caption: EXHIBIT 4-39 Setting Elevations of Steam Turbines — CONDENSING TURBINE / SURFACE CONDENSER ARRANGEMENT 'C'. Hand-drawn elevation sketch showing a condensing turbine on a concrete pedestal with expansion joint on the turbine exhaust, transition piece down to a surface condenser (reference Exhibit 4.8), and a vertical condensate pump (reference Exhibit 4.7) set into the ground below; MIN dimension between condenser bottom and pump; MOTOR LINE reference elevation on the left; NPSH requirements (reference Exhibit 4.27) noted at the pump.

CONDENSING TURBINE TOP EXHAUST / ARRANGEMENT 'D'. Hand-drawn elevation sketch showing a condensing turbine on an elevated concrete table-top foundation supported on columns/piers, with exhaust piping rising vertically from the turbine top, turning 90 degrees through a long-radius elbow, and routed horizontally; MIN vertical clearance dimension called out between grade and underside of the elevated foundation. Note: THIS ARRANGEMENT WOULD ALSO APPLY FOR NON-CONDENSING TURBINES.
